name: lookup_carrier
description: Look up a motor carrier in FMCSA's public records by MC number or USDOT number, to confirm who the caller is. Call it as soon as the caller gives a number; the caller hears a short holding line while it runs. Returns the carrier's legal name, city, state and fleet size, or found: false when there is no match or the lookup timed out.

number.description: The number as digits, with "MC" or "USDOT" in front, for example "MC 196057" or "USDOT 295917". Convert spoken words to digits.

name: end_call
description: End the phone call, after you have promised the callback. The text in the goodbye field is spoken to the caller, then the line is closed.

outcome.description: lead: a carrier or owner-operator interested in dispatch. not_a_lead: anyone else with a genuine reason to call. spam: a sales call or robocall.

callback_promise.description: What you told the caller about the callback, for example "in the next few minutes" or "tomorrow between 9 and 11 AM Eastern". Empty if no callback was promised.

goodbye.description: Your closing words, spoken to the caller exactly as written. One or two short sentences, for example "Thanks, Mike. A dispatcher will call you in the next few minutes. Drive safe."
